mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 2 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 2 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment with aggressive monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the previous 2 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with PAYEMS increase > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.25% in a month and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is positive, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a growing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% in 1 month and GDPC1 growth > 0%
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in growth phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% and GDPC1 growth > 0%.
